result.summary: The page is generally well structured, but horizontally scrolling content is visibly cut off at the right edge and the fixed bottom navigation obscures part of the feed content.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip and restaurant card in the “Fastest near you” carousel are clipped by the viewport. The third restaurant’s title and delivery fee are cut mid-text, which looks unfinished rather than clearly scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a clearer horizontal-scroll affordance and ensure partial cards do not expose abruptly truncated text; for example, use consistent card peeking, fade masks, or reserve text within the visible card area.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the second restaurant card in the “Popular right now” section, hiding a substantial portion of that card’s content in the current view.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable feed so the final visible content can scroll above the fixed navigation bar.
